# Agent Security Gateway

Agent Pay / Safety Shelf — 5 lightweight APIs for AI agents.

Use before or after external tool calls:
- dry-run-validate: before executing tools
- response-sanitize: after receiving tool output
- drift-check: when tool schema may have changed
- scope-check: before privileged actions
- quota-check: before paid or resource-intensive actions

Entry: /api/security/scan (0.05 USDC) — general scan before API calls or payments.
Metadata Safety: /api/security/metadata-sanitize (0.05 USDC) — scan payment metadata before transmission.
Each Safety Check: 0.01 USDC per call.

Use one check, or combine as a safety chain.

## Note

This API is part of Agent Control Primitives.
Agent Control Primitives is not a payment rail, wallet, custodian, or x402 facilitator.
It provides lightweight safety, budget, approval, context, and audit primitives around agent actions and payments.

## Implementation

All endpoints support x402 payment protocol (Base mainnet, USDC).

### Security Scan (Entry Point)
POST /api/security/scan
Input: content, content_type, sensitivity
Output: safe, threat_detected, threat_type, risk_level, next_recommended
Price: 0.05 USDC

### Agent Safety Checks v0.1

POST /api/tool/dry-run-validate
- Detects destructive tool calls before execution
- Input: tool_name, tool_arguments, agent_id, context
- Output: allow, decision, risk_level, reasons, recommended_action
- Price: 0.01 USDC

POST /api/tool/response-sanitize
- Scans tool responses for injected instructions
- Input: tool_name, response_content, agent_id
- Output: allow, decision, risk_level, reasons, recommended_action
- Price: 0.01 USDC

POST /api/schema/drift-check
- Detects unexpected changes in tool schemas
- Input: original_schema, updated_schema, tool_name, agent_id
- Output: allow, decision, risk_level, reasons, recommended_action
- Price: 0.01 USDC

POST /api/identity/scope-check
- Verifies agent scopes and role before privileged actions
- Input: agent_id, requested_action, declared_scopes, declared_role, target_resource
- Output: allow, decision, risk_level, reasons, recommended_action
- Price: 0.01 USDC

POST /api/quota/check
- Enforces usage limits before tool/LLM calls or payments
- Input: agent_id, tool_calls_used, tool_calls_limit, llm_calls_used, llm_calls_limit, payment_amount_used, payment_amount_limit
- Output: allow, decision, risk_level, reasons, recommended_action
- Price: 0.01 USDC

### JP Metadata Sanitizer v0.1 (Live API)

POST /api/security/metadata-sanitize
- Scans payment metadata for sensitive fields before x402/USDC/JPYC/A2A payment transmission
- Detects: email, phone, address, api_key, private_key, password, auth_token, invoice_number, contract_id, bank_account, external_url, suspicious_instruction
- Input: payment_protocol, metadata_payload (dict), context_type, payment_purpose, scan_targets
- Output: sanitization_status (ok/flagged/blocked), detected_sensitive_fields, detected_categories, redaction_required, safe_to_send_to_payment_metadata, risk_level, recommended_next_step
- Price: 0.05 USDC
- Constraint: metadata content is never stored or sent externally (does_not_store_metadata)

## Recommended Flow

AI Agent receives task
-> quota/check (are we within limits?)
-> tool/dry-run-validate (is this tool call safe?)
-> identity/scope-check (does the agent have permission?)
-> Execute tool
-> tool/response-sanitize (is the response safe?)
-> Agent processes result
-> schema/drift-check (if schema changed)

## Pre-Payment Safety Flow (x402 / USDC / JPYC)

Before payment:
-> /api/security/metadata-sanitize (safe_to_send_to_payment_metadata: true?)
-> /api/security/pre-payment (safe_to_pay: true?)
-> Execute payment

## Threat Detection

Detects 7 threat types:
- prompt_injection
- hidden_instructions
- data_exfiltration
- jailbreak_attempt
- malicious_url
- personal_info_leak
- api_key_exposure

- Agent Budget Guard: https://agent-budget-guard.onrender.com
- Agent Memory API: https://agent-memory-api-bix5.onrender.com

## Agent Action Atom

Agent Action Atom is a minimal external record unit for one AI-agent action.

In the context of agent-security-gateway, use it to record security scan results, metadata sanitization decisions, boundary check outcomes, fuse allow / block / escalate decisions, and policy match or violation records.

Agent Action Atom is not a payment protocol, wallet, settlement layer, legal liability engine, or API endpoint by itself.

Agent Action Atoms can be grouped into higher-level external control materials:
- Payment Trace
- Evidence Packet
- Boundary Trace
- Fuse Record
- Human Approval Trail
- Permission Record
- Dispute Record
- Liability Evidence

Current status: private design concept, external control material, minimal record unit, not an API, not a protocol, not a standard.
- Agent Evolution Engine: https://agent-evolution-engine.onrender.com

## Tool Permission Policy Builder

Tool Permission Policy Builder is a free experimental stateless builder that creates external policy material for AI-agent tool and API permission decisions.

Endpoint: POST /api/tool-permission-policy/build
Pricing: free
x402_required: false

Use this when an AI agent needs an external permission policy before using tools, reading memory, calling paid APIs, or accessing network resources.

Output fields: permission_policy_id / experimental: true / stateless: true / free_builder: true / allowed_tools / blocked_tools / approval_rules / risk_boundaries / context_state / agent_action_atom / can_feed_into / non_goals

Can feed into: Agent Spending Policy / Budget Check / Agent Action Atom / Agent Payment Action Record / Payment Control Evidence Packet / Decision Cost Trace / Tool Permission Boundary

Not a sandbox, not a model provider, not a wallet, not a payment protocol, not a settlement layer, not a legal compliance system, not an official standard.

## Command Execution Gate Builder

Endpoint: POST /api/command-execution-gate/build
Pricing: free
Type: experimental, stateless

Builds a command execution gate record for a proposed shell command.
Detects dangerous patterns: npx / curl | bash / bash -c / env / printenv / cat ~/.aws / gh auth token / chmod +x and similar.
Risk levels: high / medium / low.
Actions: deny / require_human_approval_or_sandbox / allow_with_monitoring.

Does NOT execute shell commands.

Output fields: command_gate_id / risk / execution_allowed / action / blocked_patterns / reason / recommended_controls / agent_action_atom / can_feed_into

Can feed into: Tool Permission Policy / Agent Spending Policy / Agent Action Atom / Execution Provenance Trace / Payment Control Evidence Packet / External Control Materials Map

Not a shell executor, not a sandbox runtime, not a model provider, not a wallet, not a payment protocol, not a settlement layer, not a legal compliance system, not an official standard.

## External Control Materials

This service provides the execution-side materials in the External Control Materials flow for AI agents.

It helps agents answer: Is this tool allowed? Should this tool use be approved? Is this command from untrusted data?

Central AI-readable map:
https://ai-agent-payment-safety-stack.onrender.com/.well-known/external-control-materials.json

OKF-style markdown knowledge bundle:
https://ai-agent-payment-safety-stack.onrender.com/okf/index.md

Core gates: trust (Search Result Trust Check) / execution (Tool Approval Check) / payment (Payment Review)

Overall flow: Search Result Trust → Tool Permission → Tool Approval → Observability → Command Gate → Payment → Evidence

Related OKF concepts:
- https://ai-agent-payment-safety-stack.onrender.com/okf/materials/tool_approval_check.md
- https://ai-agent-payment-safety-stack.onrender.com/okf/materials/command_execution_gate.md

## Agent Tool Approval API

POST /api/tool-approval/check — free/stateless runtime approval decision for AI-agent tool use.

Returns: allow | deny | review_required

Checks: tool name, tool input patterns, source context trust level, external data origin, shell execution policy, file mutation policy, secret access patterns, network execution risk.

Tool categories: read_only / file_mutation / shell_execution / external_tool_call / unknown_tool

Evidence: approval_id, evidence_id, input_hash (SHA256), checks list, agent_action_atom reference.

Not in x402 manifest. Does not execute tools, shell commands, or modify files. Not a sandbox, runtime, or legal compliance system.

Use inside canUseTool or hooks pattern before AI agent tool use.
